question: Does measuring the complete first six-variable-site loop record change a later local charge law relative to the J6W selected-first instrument, and can a three-edge path yield first-conditioned information at a newly eligible third site after two actions?
role: Two independent bounded exact ideal-state discriminators; neither is a full second/third public record, noisy D4 history, decoder risk or threshold
source_basis: Jing Appendix A.2/A.4 ordered flux-free charge projections and red-X correction
J6L/J6M periodic L=2 operator support and one common vacuum orbit
J6W local-only loop and three-block results and their explicit omitted-dephasing boundary

common.geometry_and_state: Frozen J6L periodic L=2 graph and one J6M anyon-free orbit; private red-X error support, ideal projectors and no readout noise
common.timing: Apply physical red-X; measure specified eligible first stars; apply first public red-X correction; measure specified eligible second stars; for the path branch apply a second public correction then measure one newly eligible third star.
common.public_private_boundary: Only explicitly measured local outcomes count as records. Physical error support, operator masks and site-selection diagnostics remain private. The loop first block is complete over its six variable sites with all other eligible initial stars verified +1; its second block measures only one star. The path branch uses selected local blocks and is not a complete public history.
common.independent_unit: One fixed exact orbit per geometry with counterfactual action branches and rational Born masses; no Monte Carlo uncertainty

loop_full_first_dephasing.first_rule: Measure all eligible first stars; require exactly six non-deterministic ones, with all other eligible stars +1 on the prepared error state. Enumerate all 64 binary assignments, retain only positive outcomes.
loop_full_first_dephasing.contrast: For each first full record compute the exact conditional second-site-17 law; then aggregate over four omitted first bits conditional on selected first sites [0,1] and compare with J6W's two-site-only first instrument at the same action and second site. A difference is due to full-first measurement/dephasing in this fixture, not a full second record.

three_edge_new_third.first_rule: Measure all eligible first stars; require at most two non-deterministic first sites and all other eligible first stars +1.
three_edge_new_third.second_rule: Measure the two smallest eligible second sites with nonzero unconditional variance after first action; require exactly two.
three_edge_new_third.third_rule: Measure the smallest site newly eligible after the second action, requiring at least one and that the selected third operator differs from every selected first/second operator. Compare its exact conditional law across positive first records at fixed selected second record.
three_edge_new_third.negative_control: Classify unchanged-operator repeats and zero/one positive-prefix cases as non-discriminating, never as novel feedback.

acceptance: All five pins, physical incidence and actual-sector eligibility/commutation pass

The loop first six-site joint law is nonnegative and normalized and every positive full-first prefix has a normalized second-site conditional law, or the loop branch is explicitly censored before claiming a full-first result at the common CPU cap

The three-edge first/second/third selected-star sequence retains ordered Born sandwiches; each positive prefix normalizes, and the chosen third site is newly eligible with a non-repeated operator, or that branch is explicitly censored
Report full-first-versus-selected-first loop contrast and third-site first dependence separately with their local/full-record boundaries
No stochastic histories, schedule-arm evaluations, bootstrap, five-round caller changes, full second/third public law, decoder comparison or threshold claim
stop_rule: Run the cheaper three-edge branch first, then the loop branch. Fail closed on pin/incidence/commutation drift or negative/unnormalized mass. If selected-site structural gates or the 60-CPU-second common cap fail, mark only the affected branch censored and retain valid independent evidence; never widen the cap or change sites/actions post hoc.
